name: Snare
description: Trap an enemy who enters this landmark — their team is frozen in place for 8 minutes.

name: Slow Trap
description: An enemy who enters here drags their team to a crawl (slow walk) for 5 minutes.

name: Quarantine Field
description: An enemy who enters here scatters their team — each member must stay 50 m apart for 15 minutes.
